title: To: Maria Lopez · From: Hiring Team, Castell Logistics · Subject: Interview invitation
L: Dear Ms. Lopez, Thank you for applying for the position of warehouse supervisor.
We were very impressed with your experience and would like to invite you to an interview on Tuesday, May 12, at 10:00 A.M.
You will meet the operations manager and two team leaders.
The interview will last about forty-five minutes.
Please bring a copy of your driver's license and any certificates you have received.
If this time is not convenient, please reply to this e-mail by Friday.

exq.why: be impressed with: ấn tượng với (tính từ -ed chỉ cảm xúc của người).

exq.a: You will meet the operations manager and two team leaders.
w: Unfortunately, we have decided not to offer you an interview.
Your interview with our team took place last Tuesday.
We have already filled the warehouse supervisor position.
exq.why: Câu chèn nói ai sẽ phỏng vấn, nối với câu sau về thời lượng buổi phỏng vấn. Ba câu kia ngược với thư mời: không mời phỏng vấn, phỏng vấn đã diễn ra, đã tuyển xong.
any + danh từ: any certificates (chứng chỉ).
by + thời hạn: trả lời trước / chậm nhất thứ Sáu.
